import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
run=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
read=lambda p: json.loads((run/p).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
stdout=(run/'stdout.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
row=read('live-evidence/R01.json')
ledger=read('probe-ledger.json')
receipt=read('run-receipt.json')
conditions={
 'pytest_selected_one_r01': '1 failed, 4 deselected' in stdout and 'R01-keke-' in stdout,
 'pytest_failed_as_expected': receipt['exit_code']==1 and 'json.decoder.JSONDecodeError' in stdout,
 'case_failed_as_observer_probe': row['passed'] is False and row['error_type']=='JSONDecodeError',
 'selection_message_and_actual_card_saved': row.get('selection_message')=='就选'+row['selected_card']['name']+'，两瓶' and row['selected_card']['sku_id']=='demo:cn-coke-zero-500ml-bottle',
 'seeded_product_read_over_public_api': ledger['seeded_product']['http_status']==200 and ledger['seeded_product']['sku_id']=='demo:cn-coke-zero-500ml-bottle',
 'selection_http_200_saved_before_parse': row.get('selection_http_status')==200 and 'malformed-json' in row.get('selection_sse',''),
 'selection_timing_positive': isinstance(row.get('selection_backend_wall_ms'),(int,float)) and row['selection_backend_wall_ms']>0,
 'first_turn_readonly_card': row.get('route',{}).get('status')=='completed' and row.get('route',{}).get('decision')=='stay_current' and row.get('selected_card',{}).get('sku_id')=='demo:cn-coke-zero-500ml-bottle',
 'no_business_completion_claim': row.get('selection_route') is None and row.get('plan') is None,
 'no_model_or_external_http_call': row.get('upstream')==[] and ledger.get('blocked_http')==[],
 'source_306_stable': receipt.get('source_stable_306') is True,
 'review_scope_14_stable': receipt.get('review_scope_stable_14') is True,
 'v6_zip_matches': receipt['freeze_gate']['candidate_zip_matches'] is True,
}
artifacts=['process-start.json','run-receipt.json','freeze-gate.json','source-after.json','stdout.txt','stderr.txt','probe-ledger.json','live-evidence/R01.json','live-evidence/R01.sha256','run-probe.py','plugin/malformed_selection_probe.py']
hashes={p:hashlib.sha256((run/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in artifacts}
result={'kind':'controlled-observer-only; not a business/core/Q20 pass',
 'expected_behavior':'R01 selection malformed SSE JSONDecodeError propagates from events(selected); pytest exit 1',
 'conditions':conditions,'all_conditions_match':all(conditions.values()),
 'pytest_exit_code':receipt['exit_code'],'pid':receipt['pid'],'source_306_stable':receipt['source_stable_306'],
 'review_scope_14_stable':receipt['review_scope_stable_14'],'external_boundary':'TestClient sends are intercepted at public send; non-testserver HTTP sends are rejected at httpx/httpx2 public send boundaries; no upstream send recorded.',
 'artifact_sha256':hashes}
(run/'probe-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
(run/'artifact-sha256.json').write_text(json.dumps(hashes,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'all_conditions_match':result['all_conditions_match'],'conditions':conditions,'verification':str(run/'probe-verification.json')},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
